notes.title: Elemental Summons are here!!!
notes.content:
Hello survivors!

It's been awhile! But your intrepid devs have been hard at work for this big big update! Hope you're ready for this!!!

The biggest thing that we've added is.... ELEMENTAL SUMMONS!!!! Yes!!! You will be able to summon huge elemental beings that will wipe out every enemy on the screen! Here's how it works:

Step 1: Unlock the NEW Faerie Caps area.
Step 2: Defeat the final boss in the Faerie Caps area.
Step 3: Defeat 10,000 enemies in one of the first four areas to spawn a mysterious crystal!
Step 4: Find and shatter the crystal with attacks to summon a great Elemental Beast and its guardians!
Step 5: Slay the Elemental Beast! Now all characters with the same elemental affinity will have that Elemental Summon unlocked!
Step 6: Go to any area with a character of matching elemental affinity and defeat enemies to fill your Soul Bar.
Step 7: Trigger that summon and witness the devastation!!!

This update includes the first four summons: Eikthyrnir (nature), Zomok (wind), Kulshedra (witchcraft), and Phoenix (fire). We'll be releasing more summons in future updates!

As well, please peruse this enormous list of changes. We've lowered the cost of many permanent upgrades! Be sure to refund your upgrades and repurchase for the reduced price.

Bug fixes and tweaks:

 Reduced the price of many permanent upgrades. Be sure to refund and repurchase!
 "First options only" achievement fixed.
 Fixed bug when closing the music or accessibility menu with escape.
 Fixed bug with double rerolls.
 Fixed bug with multiple menus opening.
 Fixed bug with crashes navigating the music select menu on Steam Deck.
 Slowdown improved.
 Tweaked hitbox for Magic Missile Swarm and Arrow Strike.
 Arrow Strike size now affected by projectile size.
 Holy Nail now targets two enemies at once.
 Magic Cards and Poison Riceball evos fixed.
 Fireball, Backslash, Axe Volley, and Summon Pet evos tweaked.
 Fixed menus and sounds layering when levelling up multiple times. This may affect how fast you level and may also affect balance.
 Fixed maxed evo zoom while in Journey mode.
 Turned off menu input while travelling to area selected.
 Fixed shop spawning in Journey mode.

Added:

 Added the Faerie Caps area.
 Achievement to unlock Elemental Summon Crystal spawns.
 Added Elemental Beast Crystal spawns to first four areas.
 Achievements to unlock the Elemental Summons for the first four areas.
 Added Elemental Summons for nature, wind, witchcraft, and fire.
 Added Elemental Summon Bar Speed achievement and upgrades.
 Added the Cherub character.
 Added the Soul Sweep attack.
 Added the Glitter Bee character.
 Added the Glitter Heal "attack".
 Lots of new/updated sound effects.

We truly hope you'll enjoy these changes and additions, and welcome your feedback. If we didn't get to your bug or suggestion yet, the next update won't be too far away!

As always, you can join our Discord to chat with other survivors and give us feedback and ideas.

Have fun out there y'all!

<3 The Samobee Team

notes.title: v0.2.30 - New Journey Mode!
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

We have an exciting update to celebrate the Bullet-Heaven Fest today! Be sure to check out all the awesome bullet-heaven games involved in this festival... there are so many to try!

This update includes a new gameplay mode: Journey Mode! Once you've completed the first area, this mode will unlock. It's a constantly escalating roguelike mode to challenge more experienced players! You can access it from the Area Selection screen by pressing J on the keyboard or Y on your controller. You'll be airship dropped into increasingly difficult random areas for 1-minute each. We've also added leaderboards! You'll be able to compare how long you lasted overall, and by character! See how high you can rank!


 Added Journey Mode.
 Added possible fix to not unlocking the Favour Steam achievement when the secret is unlocked.
 Increased magnet/gold magnet chances for all areas.
 Added overload percent information in the HUD.
 Increased max speed cap.
 Magic Lance and Poison Riceball evolutions keep the base attack active in addition to the new attack.
 Increased difficulty of the first area.
 Added art to the Cleric in character select to indicate she is easier to start (choose her if you are new to the genre or want to just chill).
 Removed XP bonus from Expert difficulty.
 Holy Ring attack tweaked: reduced damage, increased cooldown, and decreased Paladin's damage boost.
 Added spawns into areas that can appear longer after the final boss appears.


We'd love your feedback on these updates! The difficulty boost in the 1st area should make it more of a challenge for new players. Try refunding your upgrades to test it out, if you dare!

The updates to Magic Lance and Poison Riceball are in response to feedback that players felt evolving these attacks changed the gameplay too much. So now... you get both! If there are other attacks that you feel change too much after being evolved, let us know and we can look into adding those to this new system. Note that the cooldowns for the base version of these attacks will run in the background and won't appear on the HUD anymore.

We added a graphic to indicate that Crystal the Cleric is a good character to start with if you're new to the genre or want a more chill session. We have tweaked the Holy Ring a bit to make it not so blazingly enemy-blending, so let us know how it feels. We're aiming for "fun challenge without making you question your life choices".

Have fun trying out all the awesome games in the Bullet-Heaven Fest! And feel free to hop into our Discord as we'll probably be discussing our favourites in there (we already are)!

Keep on surviving!
<3 The Samobee Team

Hello survivors!

notes.title: v0.2.14 - More balance tweaks plus a thank you gift!
notes.content:
First off, we want to thank everyone for your patience as we work on balance issues. We've been tweaking and testing non-stop since the big update yesterday, and we feel we're finally at a point where it's still easy, but challenging, plus you won't be spammed non-stop with levelup menus.

So as a token of our deep appreciation for everyone, we're giving you 50k zil. All you have to do is boot up the new version, and the zil will be added to your wallet. (Note this is for Early Access players only.) <3 <3

As well, we've made the following fixes/tweaks:

 XP drop values tweaked based on game timer.
 XP requirements tweaked down again. We'd love your feedback!
 Added menu navigation for the perm upgrades menu.
 Fixed bug with unlocking Banish.
 Fixed Steam Cloud load if no local file.
 Added extra check to see if Gloom should be unlocked in Early Access. Let us know if this isn't working please!
 Added alpha value to Bolt Storm.


So yeah, we're feeling pretty overwhelmed by your support and patience, so thank you all. We <3 you!

Keep those ideas and feedback coming! <3

<3 <3 The Samobee Team

notes.title: v0.2.11 - Big balance update!
notes.content:
We've got a big update for y'all today! The biggest is probably the balance. Folks have been saying that it feels "too easy" or "too slow". Well, we've rebalanced a lot so it will be more of a challenge. Lean on those permanent upgrades to help you out! We welcome feedback on this change, and anything else.

We'll be posting a Roadmap soon of features/tweaks that will be coming up. Feedback is welcome!

Here's a list of alllll of the changes today!

 Rebalanced XP needed to level, which has changed the difficulty of the game. We would love your feedback on this.
 Tracking which attack slot hit the enemy last, and if the attack is different it will do damage.
 Can now damage enemies in knockback state.
 Bosses can no longer be knocked past the borders of the room, and will not spawn inside the wall.
 Tweaked Divine Beam to target random on screen enemy that can be damaged (instead of the nearest) and extended the maximum distance it can travel, how long it can last, plus removed the pierce damage reduction. The distance and how long it can last will be affected by projectile count.
 Added Steam screenshot ability.
 Added more details to Levelup Menu for equipment.
 Added local backup saves and tweaked load script to give preference to the most recent save file (Steam Cloud/local).
 Increased the chance for towns to spawn per timer.
 Changed how % appears in the perm upgrades menu (it will show +25% instead of 125%). This does not affect the actual values, just the way they are written.
 Fixed bug with red X on the levelend screen when area boss defeated.
 Fixed bug with pause and Steam Overlay.
 Added Banish secret, and menu in titlescreen, plus permanent upgrades to increase the count, when unlocked.
 Added area Enemy Overload secrets.
 Added transparency to Magic Cards base and evo attacks.


Thanks everyone for playing!

<3 <3 The Samobee Team

This has been a whirlwind with releasing and reading the feedback from everyone! It's been incredible and wonderful! Thank you all so much.

We'll still have an update that will go out on Friday with some more new content and any other tweaks we make based on player feedback.

Don't forget! You can always join our Discord to chat about your ideas and report bugs too!

<3 The Samobee Team

notes.title: Announcing Early Access Release Date - August 25, 2023!!!
notes.content:
We are SO THRILLED to announce the Early Access release date for Elemental Survivors: coming August 25, 2023!!!

To celebrate we've added some exciting new stuff, plus some basic fixes:

 Evos! Yes! Attack evolutions! Check out the secrets menu to see what all you need to do to get these started, and how to get more. *you start with 1 available per round; more will be available to unlock and purchase in Early Access
 Lots more minidiscs! Check out the secrets menu to find out how to get them all.
 Increased coin drops from torches.
 No more coin pull at the end of runs (you'll get plenty during the level, don't worry).
 Bombs now work differently... check them out!
 Backslash is now the Shadowless Slash and aims (manual aim direction or auto aim nearest enemy) with a follow up projectile for each combo.
 Some balance tweaks for attacks, including cooldowns and damage.
 Returning from the endgame screen no longer directs you to the permanent upgrades menu.
 Some fun effects when you get a max chest.
 Some attacks can destroy enemy projectiles.
 Max 5 magnets can be on the field at one time.
 Fixed glitch with tornado animations not disappearing.
 More perm upgrade levels to purchase.
 Broadstrike now aims (manual aim direction or auto aim nearest enemy, to the right or left).
 Some new sound effects for attacks, plus player death sound effect, and some enemy spawn sound effects.

We hope you enjoy these additions and would love to hear your thoughts, here or in our Discord!

Have a lovely week and happy blending!! 

<3 <3 The Samobee Team

notes.title: v0.1.15 - Quest system and auto-aim updates
notes.content:
Once again, we're listening to the feedback and making some quality of life updates, fixes, and changes! The biggest change this time is the quest system! You can now complete multiple quests in the same run, instead of just a single quest. The other big change is that some attacks will now auto-aim at the nearest enemy when your aim type is set to auto.


 Quests can now be completed separately in a single run (no need to do a run per quest).
 Increased spawn distance from player if spawning onscreen.
 Can trigger endgame screen close after the block transition is complete (no need to wait for the player to journey across the levelbar).
 Added quick replay button to endgame screen (will restart that level with the same difficulty and main character).
 If an enemy has been hit by a party member, the player can still hit the enemy.
 Zil earned when all items at max for levelup and chest drops now affected by player bonuses and permanent upgrades, rather than a fixed number.
 Arrowshot, Ice Hammer, Fireball, Slash, and Holy Strike when aim-type is set to auto-aim will now auto-aim at the nearest enemy instead of facing direction/random.
 Enemies who shoot projectiles will have a longer delay after spawning before they fire first projectile.
 Lowered cooldown time for Ice Spike.
 Fixed issue with levelling up Paladin not showing the correct max stat in HUD.
 Added stat boxes under the character attacks in the character selection screen.
 Changed stat text to stat box sprites in HUD.
 Sped up Ice Spike animations.
 New bomb explosions.
 Final damage count up will be accurate to the damage actually done (not the potential damage). Both are shown in endgame screen.
 Reduced Side Slice scale increase at max level.
 Tweaked several character stat increases and bonuses.
 Bumped up holy strike's damage levelling.
 Tornado sounds fixed.
 Set max number of sounds at one time.
 Brutal swing and tornado now semi-transparent.
 Fixed player damaging enemies when they've been hit by party members.
 Fixed tornado, axe launch, and riceball attacks when game is paused.
 Fixed leather armour resetting player speed.
 Fixed final boss finishing game issue if more than one.
 Fixed player dead x drawing while player moved along level bar in endgame screen.
 Changed knight's bonuses to magic/vitality/defense based.
 Fixed issue with Lum not being available in other areas after being unlocked.
 Fixed party attack scaling.


We love hearing your feedback and ideas! Keep them coming!

<3 <3 The Samobee Team

notes.title: v0.1.12 - Difficulty settings!
notes.content:
We've been continuing to gather feedback from players, so thank you so much!

One of the main things we've been hearing is "too easy". Well, here's a solution to that! If you're up for the challenge or if you have lots of experience with similar games, you'll want to change the difficulty to Expert when you're selecting your area. This will affect the enemies and give you greater rewards. We'll have more difficulty settings when we've tested the balance more, but we wanted to get Expert into your hot little hands ASAP!!! We hope you enjoy this addition! We've also made the following changes and additions for this build:


 Added difficulty settings that affect enemy spawns, damage, speed, projectiles, and health, plus the rewards of zil and xp.
 Fixed tornados so you can't damage enemies while they are inside the tornado.
 Bosses will only be damaged when hit by a tornado, not picked up.
 Vierra as a party member will drop bombs even when you're moving.
 Added right stick controls in menus in game.
 Fixed collision masks on area features that the player shouldn't collide with.
 If all items are at max, and health is at max, will automatically add zil if levelling up.
 Updated the name of Luck Armour to XP Armour.
 Fixed crash with tornado party attack.
 Manual aim type when first starting a game with no save file: if you have a controller connected, will be set to controller type, and if you don't, it will be set to mouse.
 If loading up a save game and your previous manual aim type was controller and you do not have a controller connected, it will be set to mouse.


We really appreciate everyone who has tried out Elemental Survivors! We're really excited for all the content we're adding that will be available when we launch Early Access!

Have a lovely Steam Next Fest!
<3 The Samobee Team

 Ice hammer will not get destroyed if it goes off screen.
 Fixed manual aim for the slash attack.
 Fixed towns/shops spawning in lakes/mountains.
 Fixed issue with elemental attacks scaling from one playthrough to the next.
 Possible fix for chests spawning inside mountains/lakes. If this continues to happen, please let us know!
 Increased Cleric's starting dexterity to speed her up a bit.
 Added enemy behaviours.
 Added enemy spawn types.
 All attacks unlocked for demo (except Gloom's).
 PSX controller should be detected upon launch now.
 Added "party transparency" setting in the settings menu. This will set party members' transparency if they are distracting you.
 Upon finishing a round, if the player can afford permanent upgrades, the permanent upgrade menu will automatically open.


The biggest change with this build are the enemies! Now they have different spawn types (groups, onscreen/offscreen, and patterns), different behaviours (some will fire projectiles, some will stand in place, some will be cautious, some will rush across the screen, some will see your devastation and flee!) We would love your feedback on these changes.

As always, we will do our best to be as responsive as possible. Not all suggestions will make it into the game (or they will be part of future plans), but thank you for taking the time to play and share your ideas! 

<3 Samobee

notes.title: v0.1.6 - Mouse manual aim and main character leveling!
notes.content:
We've been continuing to gather feedback from players and have made the following changes and additions for this build:


 Added mouse manual aim, so there are three settings now: controller manual aim with right stick, mouse manual aim, and auto aim. Make sure to select your preferred method in the settings menu! If you have any issues with this, please kindly let us know the specifics of what happened and what you expected to happen.
 Tweaked holy ring damage/knockback levelling down for later levels.
 Fixed bug where the simple band did not increase the holy ring's scale.
 Changed terminology from "Magic holyring" to "Holy ring".
 Adjusted collision code to allow for easier navigation with obstacles/mountains.
 Player main character now levels just like a party member and provides the same bonuses.
 Added level pips beneath main character name to show current level.
 Added chest popups to detail what was leveled and how.
 Notepad (and the shortcut keys listed on it) removed from titlescreen.
 Future saves will store fullscreen state.


We hope you're enjoying the demo, and we will continue to be as responsive as humanly possible (we are two people, after all!), while also building the game for Early Access. 

One piece of feedback we want to acknowledge is about the enemies. We absolutely are working on enemy behaviours and patterns, so watch for that in the future but it will be a bit slower coming than the changes we've been able to make based on feedback thus far. There's lots of other things we were already working towards, including attack evolutions. So just know that lots of cool stuff is happening over here! This is just a taste of what's to come!

Keep your ideas and feedback coming! Feel free to join our Discord to further discuss your thoughts. We're a positive and supportive bunch in there! <3 <3 -B

notes.title: v0.1.5 Demo Updates!
notes.content:
Lots of updates! Upon receiving feedback from players like you, we've made the following changes:


 Added "manual aim" option in the settings screen (default will be on).
 Added right stick input for direction of directional attacks. Other attacks will continue to be based on other factors (eg. nearest enemy, random enemy). The arrow around the player will point in the direction that the character is aiming.
 Increased many of the characters' stats.
 Increased character's speed.
 Increased enemy speed.
 Bosses will not be affected by collisions with normal tier enemies.
 Increased perm upgrade cap on the demo for attack, party, and equipment slots by 1.
 Changed SPR to SPI.
 Slash attack is now directional to the way the player is facing.
 Added X to exit menus (does not include levelup, equipment, or party select menus in game).
 Added character unlock info for area quest selection menu.
 Added highlight to highest stat markers in the levelup menu and HUD.
 Added left stick menu navigation.
 Added menu selection looping in settings menu.
 Updated wording for many descriptions, including for magic missile swarm (it does not target most powerful enemy, just a random one).


Keep that feedback coming! We love it! <3 <3

notes.title: v0.1.4 - hofix for defeating final boss
notes.content:
A couple of hotfixes for the demo:

 Fixed bug where defeating the final area boss didn't earn the area gem.
 Fixed bug with HUD music player crashing if navigating to a song outside of the current disc's index.

notes.title: Devlog #1: Welcome to Elemental Survivors!
notes.content:
Our first devlog!

Welcome to Elemental Survivors, an auto-attacking RPG where you and your party plow through hordes of enemies.

We plan to be in Early Access Q2 2023, and cannot wait to hear everyone's feedback.

We've been gathering input from a special crew of Alpha Testers, and the game is shaping up amazingly AND quickly! We already have 4 playable areas, 8 selectable characters as main or party members, 13 super devastating attacks, almost 300 enemies, plus a plethora of equipment and permanent upgrades to buff your builds.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43769366/1be3a045a1197d6d27fdf17ef66efa928f53ebfa.png

Since we just finished making the trailer (which was super hard to do omg), we'll change our focus to adding more content including: 

 More characters
 More attacks
 More enemies
 More areas
 Area features, like water and fog


Here's a sneak peek at one of the characters we'll be adding. His name is Gloom and he's just a gloomy boy with a huge ass sword.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43769366/e32eada0ccbcd20865471fc2b58e3b66225e2a9f.png

We have SO MUCH planned to be added before Early Access launch, and I'll be keeping you updated on our progress. In the meantime, you can join our Samobee Discord or comment here to share ideas and hype with us.
